title: A convergent finite element method with minimal deformation rate for mean curvature flow
summary: We propose and analyze a fully discrete parametric finite element method with minimal deformation rate (MDR) for simulating the mean curvature flow of general closed surfaces in three dimensions. The method is formulated from a coupled system that enforces the mean curvature flow law for the normal velocity while introducing an artificial tangential velocity that minimizes the deformation-rate energy, thereby preserving mesh quality without requiring remeshing or reparametrization. An $L^{2}$-projected averaged normal vector is used in the scheme to facilitate a rigorous convergence…
